title: Spicy Carrot Flatbread with Arugula, Apricots, Almonds & Minted Yogurt

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel, trim, and slice carrots into ¼-inch thick rounds. Place in a large bowl along with maple syrup, oil, and salt; toss to coat.

Transfer carrots to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in a single layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until fork-tender, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

While the carrots are roasting, arrange flatbreads on another large baking sheet. Add to the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl along with yogurt and salt; stir to combine and set aside.
Peel and mince the garlic. Transfer to the reserved bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the garlic; add oil, maple syrup, salt, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Thinly slice apricots and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Roughly chop almonds and set aside.
Once the carrots have cooled to room temperature, transfer to the bowl with the dressing.
Add arugula to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide minted yogurt between flatbreads and spread out in an even layer. Top each flatbread with carrot-arugula salad and slice into wedges.
To serve, divide flatbreads between plates. Sprinkle with almonds and drizzle with vinegar. Enjoy!
